Conference season: Rodrigo Gomez-Fell presented a poster and lightning talk at the SCAR Open
Science Conference in Oslo, spoke at the ASAR Workshop/RCM Users' Forum in Canada, and gave a
guest lecture at the Université de Sherbrooke. The presentations are listed under
[Conference papers and abstracts](../publications.qmd#conference), and the lecture on the
[Teaching](../teaching.qmd#lectures) page.
